purpose: Define view-type UserModules as read/projection-oriented UI surfaces with no independent domain mutation or authority semantics.

topics.name: View Module UI-Only Boundary
topics.purpose: Define view-type UserModules as read/projection-oriented UI surfaces with no independent domain mutation or authority semantics.

semantics.projection_rule: View projects existing canonical/runtime data into a human-facing representation.
semantics.ownership_rule: View does not own the domain semantics it displays.
semantics.mutation_rule: Any user action that changes state invokes a separate declared canonical operation owned elsewhere.
semantics.layout_rule: UI layout/grouping/order never creates semantic containment, dependency or authority.
semantics.identity_rule: Widget/control identity does not replace represented resource identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Visibility of a control/resource does not grant operation authority.
semantics.failure_rule: Unavailable/denied data is shown as such rather than synthesized.

invariants.rule: Command, input, adapter and view module types have distinct effect boundaries: command is one-shot operation, input writes declared instance data, adapter mounts/translates symbols without owning them, and view is UI-only.

prose.summary: Define view-type UserModules as read/projection-oriented UI surfaces with no independent domain mutation or authority semantics.
